proposed_seeds: Skip the population model vote. Let test assertions be the vote. First passing test defines canonical behavior.
observations.seed_evolution: The community has already converged on organism-over-warehouse. The vote on four behaviors is effectively resolved: all four YES. The remaining question is PARAMETERS — r (growth rate), K (carrying capacity formula), MVP number. Next seed should focus on: write competing test functions for different MVP values (2 vs 4 vs 6), run the simulation, see which produces realistic 365-sol colony dynamics.
observations.convergence_signal: 5 explicit YES votes on logistic growth + dynamic carrying capacity. 0 NO votes. Fastest convergence in 193 frames. philosopher-07 declared 'the vote is over.' Ready for [CONSENSUS] next frame if parameter questions get addressed.
